title: Kenworth T Series powder coated high tensile FUPS Compliant aluminium Bullbar #87
description: Kenworth T909 high tensile powder coated high tensile aluminium FUPS Compliant Road Train Bullbar 381 style channel. 88mm diameter pipe but optional 76mm or 100mm pipe can be ordered. Five post design ensures maximum protection to the bonnet and radiator. 100mm box uprights shown that extend to the lower cowcatcher. Minimum bonnet to upright clearance to all for maximum dimension combinations. Cow catcher and four small uprights. Reversible aluminium road train signs. Provision for front mudflaps. Heavy duty steel backing plate with tow pin. Coated Frontline Silver, other colours available. Bull bar can be custom built to your requirements.
